stage: S2 finite request allocation and conditional role diagnostics; not role/population/control adoption
known_before_protocol: Previous selected-archive context scores exposed: suitabilityAUC.54784/history-intensity.51904, block means.60146/.58590. Existing full source labels and matches already exposed. No new service fields, strict-nonroadside class counts/AUC or service scores computed.
question: Can path-based accessible demand and competition separate recorded nucleated contexts better than centre-placement intensity, including strict exclusion of roadside-tagged records?
inputs: Unchanged frozen Roman Earth400x600 inputs, original1292centre budget, priorL450intensity and private2475matched source records. All prior artifacts immutable; no new climate/population estimation.
demand: D_i=existing reference-density_i*cell_area within original allowed land. One potential request unit per reference-resident equivalent. It is not extra residents, actual rural population, money, consumed food or completed service. No food is produced or staff inferred.
candidate_mass: m_j=existing L450intensity_j*cell_area on eligible cells, globally normalized to original1292expected centres. Fractional candidate opportunities, not actual staffed places. Use unchanged fields; no source sites/labels supply candidates/counts.

transport.method: Reuse existing directional Tobler walking edges,7walking hours/offpathfactor.6, road30km/day. Terrain eta1 annual dry scenario. No ships,ferries,horses,generated roads,seasonal closures or political barriers. All land passable for paths, demand/candidates remain original allowed mask. Existing corner-cut prevention retained.
transport.kernel: For candidate j and origin i, require BOTH shortest directed legs <=B. effective t=(out+return)/2; K_ji=exp(-t/(B/2)) within cutoff,zero otherwise. No symmetry assumption for slopes. Budgets/decay are declared scenarios, not empirically fitted ancient market schedules.

allocation: Z_i=sum_j m_j K_ji. Potential choice flow_ji=D_i*m_j*K_ji/Z_i if Z_i>0,else0. A_j=sum_i flow_ji; unallocated=sum_{Z_i=0}D_i. SumA+unallocated must equal inputD; each origin apportions at most its own demand. No capacity or institutional service fulfilment is established.
predictors: uniform and unchanged suitability/history intensity references
overlapping accessible potential P_j=sum_i D_i*K_ji (not additive allocated demand)
requests per expected centre A_j/m_j, zero where m_j=0
computation: Core all model-grid cells within lat49..57/lon-7..3, fixed before scores, not archival target sites. Build a bounding crop plus halo >=ceil(2*Bmax*maximum_edge_speed/cell)+2cells. Verify actual maximum edge speed<=30km/day. Demand origins/rivals for every core candidate then fit within halo; halo scores are boundary diagnostics, only core valid. Require every formerly-included source match to be in core; do not drop sites to fit crop.

contrasts.full: Exact previous426/2049record contrast and original nine coordinate scenarios; same cell/class unit weighting and mixed ties.
contrasts.strict_nonroadside: Exclude EVERY matched source record with roadside settlement among any minor labels, even if also village/vicus. Comparison remains farm/villa. No road-derived type imputation; gate >=30representedcell/class units each at central coordinates before scoring this subset.

metrics: Same conditional rankAUC with tied cell/class units. Report full/strict subsets, all9offsets, all road/budget/field scenarios, central50km-block and region/fieldwork/AREA strata. No best-case coordinate or predictor selection, fitted coefficients, p-value claim or independent transfer.
invariants: Finite/nonnegative fields and normalized choices; per-origin request budgets, aggregate demand balance, unallocated demand, no sea/corner crossing and directed return cutoff. Compare actual sparse allocations against small dense toy fixtures. Physical outside-window/land exclusions inherited, no nearest-land rescue.
selection: Diagnostic comparison only; report all outcomes, including weak/reversed results. No default/adoption if even higherAUC. Need functional/observation model plus timing/coverage/transfer and shared food/staff/control qualification. S1c/d/e and S3–S5 remain.

consumers: The request-allocation primitive can later accept actual supported-resident demand and staffed centres from the shared ledger. It creates neither people nor political power. Any proposed functional/role map must loop into typed settlements and the SAME food/staffing/control consumers before adoption; all actors/nonstate areas included.
